input.content:

name: vendored-skill
description: Vendored description
---
# vendored-skill

Body.

[project]
name = "two-deps"

[[deps]]
id = "vendored-skill"
source = "https://github.com/example/vendored.git"
ref = "v1.2.3"
path = "nested"
license = "MIT"
scope = ["root"]

[[deps]]
id = "unsynced-skill"
source = "https://github.com/example/unsynced.git"
rev = "deadbeef"
scope = ["root"]

cases.stdout:
Usage: ai-specs skills list [path] [--help]
List vendored ([[deps]]) and local skills for a project.

Shows:
  - Installed deps from ai-specs.toml
  - Bundled skills (CLI-shipped) present in ai-specs/skills/
  - Local skills in ai-specs/skills/ (excluding vendored + bundled)
  - Available catalog skills shipped with the CLI
